comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Now encoding returnTo in OAuth state; callback decodes and navigates. Verified with /boards/7?card=1204.

content.text: Now encoding returnTo in OAuth state; callback decodes and navigates. Verified with /boards/7?card=1204.

Starting OAuth from a deep link such as /boards/42?card=881 should return the user to that board and card after the IdP round-trip. After callback the app lands on / (root dashboard) and the original path is discarded.

Post-login routing must restore returnTo from the pre-auth state. The authorize redirect stored returnTo in sessionStorage under a key that the callback page no longer reads after the auth package split.

Users opening notification emails lose context and have to hunt for the card. Restoring returnTo from the signed state parameter (already round-tripped to the IdP) fixed deep links without relying on sessionStorage.
